Alex T.: Heads up9 I found a dead fragment in the deploy runbook when following the kv-cache example: https://kb.internal/docs/deploy/kv-cache#troubleshooting previews page but the fragment 404s in the doc viewer. Can someone patch the anchor? small PR fine from me.
link-scanner-bot: Alert: file docs/deploy/kv-cache.md header mutated. Old id '#troubleshooting' removed (header now 'Troubleshooting & FAQ') 9 recommend adding explicit id or a short alias to keep legacy fragments working.
Lina M.: I can do the edit. Prefer adding explicit id on the H2 so we don't change visible text.
Tom R.: Happy to CR. Also check onboarding and setup scripts for hardcoded fragments.
Rachel H.: Codeowners for /docs/deploy are @eng-docs and @onboarding-squad 9 small doc change will require owner approval.
Alex T.: Proposed fix: add explicit id to header e.g. `## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}`. I'll run a repo ripgrep for references: `rg "kv-cache#troubleshooting" -n` and add results to PR.
Lina M.: quick perl one-liner that worked for me locally: `perl -0777 -pe \"s/## Troubleshooting(?!\s*\{)/## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}/s\" -i docs/deploy/kv-cache.md` 9 will open PR with changelog note.
Tom R.: Ping me on the PR link and I'll review fast.
Rachel H.: Tag @eng-docs in the PR description to fast-track approval.
Alex T.: Thanks all 5 opening PR in ~5m and will attach rg output.
